rows.name: email_topic_report
rows.teaching_text:
:teach email_topic_report
Look up all of my emails and group them by who they are addressed to.
Report the topics for every group and then return the report.
rows.proposal:
PROCEDURE email_topic_report(who:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND_EMAIL WHERE SELF.RECIPIENT={who}
$v1 = GROUP $v0 BY SELF.RECIPIENT
$v2 = MAP $v1 TOPIC
RETURN $v2
END

rows.name: email_topic_report
rows.teaching_text:
:teach email_topic_report
Look up all of my emails.
Sort them into groups by recipient.
Summarize the topics per group.
Please return it.
rows.proposal:
PROCEDURE email_topic_report( )
$v0 = FIND EMAIL
$v1 = GROUP $v0 BY RECIPIENT
$v2 = SUMMARIZE $v1 TOPIC
RETURN $v2
END

PROCEDURE count_requests_by_at(who:PERSON, time:TIME)
